course: AP Physics C: Electricity and Magnetism

questions.stem: A point charge $+Q$ sits at the center of a cube of side length $a$. What is the electric flux through one face of the cube?
questions.solution: Gauss's law gives the total flux through the closed cube as $\Phi_{E} = \dfrac{Q}{\varepsilon_{0}}$. By symmetry the six faces share it equally, so one face carries $\dfrac{Q}{6\varepsilon_{0}}$.
